title: アグネスデジタル登場！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The training center. No matter what time of day, she's always here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's here rain or shine, and even on the days training isn't scheduled.

text_block_list.name: Opera O and Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah! Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ooooh, Overlord T.M. Opera O. As gallant and beautiful as ever. And…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: There's Meisho Doto chasing after her with her single-minded gaze. Ahhh… Truly divine! ♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I knew there was something about those two! Before she knows it, Doto'll catch up and be welcomed with open arms. And then, at last…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ohhhh! I have to stop myself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This is Agnes Digital. She's your average Umamusume… or so she says. The one thing is—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ah, if it isn't my trainer—my kindred spirit! Look! The Umas are as wonderful as ever today!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Come. There's space for you next to me in the front row. Let us raise our prayers to our divine oshis.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She loves Umamusume with her entire heart and believes I'm as much of an "Uma simp" as she is.
choice_data_list: By the way, I have something to talk to you about.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh, okay. What is it? I don't suppose you've found a cute little newcomer ready for her debut?
choice_data_list: As a matter of fact, I have.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oooh, that's my trainer! So, what's her name?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Heheheh, that's not a bad name! Agnes Digi…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Wait, whaaat?! You don't mean…
choice_data_list: It's time to make your Twinkle Series debut.
It's time to make your Twinkle Series debut.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hooo! At last, I'm off to the land of paradise beyond the clouds—to the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Which means I'll be allowed the chance to behold, with my very own eyes, heavenly Umamusume heretofore unreachable to me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Mwahahee! I feel like I'm about to melt into a puddle of emotion! I've got so many oshis in both the dirt and turf tours.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: You remember the promise we made that day, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I could have forgotten it…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh? Sorry, I don't think I heard you right. You're telling me not to pick? That I should run both?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: To run wild? On any track I want?! Even if I'll never be as good as my oshis, I'm at least good enough to make it through the series?
choice_data_list: Yeah! You've got what it takes to be an all-rounder!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: AND IIIIIIIIII WILL ALWAYS LOVE UUUUMAS!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: All right, you've won me over! I'll be an all-rounder! I'll run turf and dirt and admire all my oshis up close!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She'll run both turf and dirt races—That's the promise I made when I signed on to be her trainer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I am an all-rounder! These tempered legs of mine will carry me beside every Umamusume there is!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: From this point forward, I'll embark on a journey building karma so that I may behold the presence of the highest order of Uma angels.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's Digital. Hello…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Do my ears deceive me, or did I just hear you announce a decision to make your debut?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ohhh… Opera O and Doto… W-well…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: These two are T.M. Opera O and Meisho Doto. They're a year above Agnes Digital.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O is a self-absorbed racer who talks the talk and walks the walk. She's already winning graded races and is a strong contender in the Classics.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ha ha ha ha! I am the Overlord! And this year's Satsuki Sho is as good as mine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the other hand, Meisho Doto is a bit clumsy. Her results are nothing to write home about, but she's known for having a hidden strength when push comes to shove.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ngh… I'm still no match for Opera O, but I'll do my best…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Digital, if it's true you are to make your debut, I would take the news with great joy, however…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: N-no! It hasn't been decided at all. That's just a baseless rumor that was put out on social media.
choice_data_list: But you just agreed with my decision.
But you just agreed with my decision.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Shhh! Hush! Don't say that! Our lips are sealed, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Aha ha ha! So, that's the issue.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Digital is afraid of the Hawthorne Effect. It's when you become overly aware of yourself because you're being observed by others.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You're… Digital's roommate Agnes Tachyon, right?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: As part of my Umamusume research, I observe her day and night. This tendency of hers was immediately obvious.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: She is afraid her existence will be a burden to other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Uh, um, I-I don't know if I would say "I'm afraid." I just feel it's kind of impudent to make them notice me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'm perfectly content to watch everyone from the quiet comfort of a priv account they can't see.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: So please, pay me no mind! I just want you excellent people to enjoy a conversation amongst yourselves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Digital's creed is that she is no more than a fan, and there must be a clear line between herself and the Umamusume she so worships.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I think it's too passive an attitude, considering she'll be competing against them moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: With that said… I'm gonna savor the golden opportunity to run in the Twinkle Series with every last fiber of my being!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: All while not getting in the way. I'll simp inconspicuously from the front lines.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: C'mon, Trainer! Now that it's decided, let's hurry up and get training!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I wanna start with the course Opera O and Doto just finished running! Their lovely scent still lingers in the air… Mmm, yes! Yessss!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Digital is afire with passion in the face of her coveted debut. She's undoubtedly an odd duck, but it's impossible to dislike her. I vow to watch over her as she builds her future.
